oneSentenceSummary: This article reports on the 2026 Volcano Engine FORCE Original Power Conference, releasing models such as Doubao 2.1 Pro and Seedance 2.5, showcasing comprehensive breakthroughs in coding, video, image, and audio capabilities, and that large models have entered the core production workflow.
originalTitle: 刚刚，Seedance 2.5 正式发布，国产视频模型再次捅破天花板
summary: The article covers the releases at the 2026 Volcano Engine FORCE Original Power Conference. Key highlights include the Doubao large model 2.1 Pro, which achieves top global tier in coding and Agent capabilities, with a cost of only 6 yuan per million token input, significantly reducing expenses; the Seedance 2.5 video model supports up to 30-second generation, joint input of 50 full-modality materials, and local video editing, breaking through mainstream model bottlenecks; the Seedream 5.0 Pro image model offers interactive precise editing and multi-layer separation; and the Seed-Audio 1.0 enables direct cinematic-quality sound effects generation. The article also notes that Doubao's daily token call volume reaches 180 trillion, with a 49.5% market share. Enterprises have deeply integrated large models into core processes, and Volcano Engine is transforming internal capabilities into cloud services delivered to customers.
title: Just Now: Seedance 2.5 Officially Released, Domestic Video Model Breaks the Ceiling Again
